done_when: forge init and forge sync install a bundled Simplified Technical English skill for Claude and Codex (its MIT instructions, writing rules, substitutions and check tool, with its license and notice, and without the standard's word list), and the guide and worker brief tell agents to write plans' top sections, pull request summaries, questions and board or next lines with it, for new and upgraded repos

findings.body: Raise: Not done — NOTICE.md says that `references/word-list.md` contains the ASD-STE100 words, despite its opening note saying Forge omits that file. LICENSE repeats the claim on lines 26–28. The installed skill therefore gives readers contradictory information and points them to a file they cannot open. The proof test checks only the opening note, so it does not catch this contradiction.
findings.title: Not done: the bundled license and notice describe a word list that is absent

why: People reading Forge's plans, pull request summaries, questions and board get long, uneven English; a controlled-language skill (Simplified Technical English) makes that text short and clear
